DashMart presence is a live shelf check of each store. Gopuff presence is per-location availability from Gopuff's own feed. Reach counts people living in the ZIP codes these stores deliver to, from Census ACS. ZIP and ZCTA boundaries differ slightly, so read it as addressable population rather than a precise count.

Sample data. Solstra is a fictional brand created to demonstrate the Vesper coverage product. The store locations and delivery ZIPs are real, but the brand and its shelf presence are illustrative.
